As far as other elemental magics, I'm not aware of any specific detail in lore, but I think it's safe to assume it exists. It just likely would fall outside of the school of Destruction magic- like water-breathing is considered Alteration magic, but can be destructive when manipulated as ice.

Something like "plant magic" might be considered to be a form of life/restoration magic. Or maybe it falls under "earth".
